title: A Ghost for the Cover
author: Isandro Halloran
blurb: Mirabel Thackeray, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
